patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: My chest is tight and I can't... catch... a full breath. My inhaler isn't cutting it. I can only get a few words out at a time.
clinical.presentationShort: 24yo F with asthma ? marked wheeze, accessory muscle use, speaking in three-word phrases; rescue inhaler no longer helping, SpO2 93%.
clinical.presentationLong: 24-year-old female with asthma whose inhaler is no longer relieving her breathing difficulty. She has widespread wheeze, uses accessory muscles, and can speak only three words at a time; oxygen saturation is 93%.

diagnosis.disposition: Acute → continuous albuterol/ipratropium, systemic steroids, oxygen, reassess; watch for fatigue or a silent chest.
diagnosis.why: Speaking in short phrases + accessory muscles = severe asthma. Stack bronchodilators and give steroids early. A silent chest is crashing.
diagnosis.redFlag: Can't finish a sentence + accessory muscles = severe; a quiet chest is worse, not better.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: leaning forward, hands on knees (tripod), working to breathe
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a black 24-year-old woman, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: leaning forward in a tripod position, hands braced on her knees, working to breathe. Expression: anxious and breathless. Clearly visible: a hunched tripod posture and the effort of hard breathing. No text, no logos.
